display_name: The whole Insurance Act 1966 under two top-level goals — a regulated person (reach, permission, the offence and its maximum penalty) and a policy (classification, validity and recoverable amount, the owner's rights, nominations and payout) — and seven goals: authorisation and conduct, ownership and control, funds and premiums, penalties, supervision and winding up, the policy, nominations
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 07 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition with later amendments to Act 5 of 2025). Every penalty in the Act tabled (78 offences). Inputs: the Authority's and the Minister's approvals, consents, opinions and discretions; prescribed amounts and exemptions; terms defined in other Acts (Companies Act 'substantial shareholder', Income Tax Act 'resident'). Carried as text: powers and procedure, listed in each module. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-07 (tests-independent.l4; 221 expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, 201 asserted in 213 assertions): 212 passed first time; the disagreement (s 147 at age 10 or under) and a further observation (s 132(7)(b)) were resolved by forks F8 and F9; all 213 now pass. Triage in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md and NOTES.md section 5. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F3: s 142(7): composition is half the fine prescribed for the kind of offender, before s 143 doubling.

forks.F5: s 146(2): the insurable-interest cap applies only where the policy stands on (1)(a) alone.
forks.F6: s 27(1): 'substantial shareholder' (Companies Act s 81) is an input.
forks.F7: ss 37, 89: a loan exactly at the limit is allowed.
